announcements.title: Interested in Joining the Body of Christ at CPC?
announcements.description:
We consider the church an essential element of the gospel, so joining CPC as a member is a way to truly join the body of Christ, in all its blessings and with all its flaws! Before joining, you’ll meet one-on-one with a pastor and then discuss how you’ve come to know Christ with the Shepherd Leaders. Email admin@cpcnewhaven.org to begin the process.
Our next joining will take place on Sunday, November 15.

announcements.title: Thanksgiving Fellowship Meals | Thursday, November 26
announcements.description:
Sign up here as host or guest
Staying local for Thanksgiving? Come celebrate with your brothers and sisters in Christ! As we’ve done in the past, we’re coordinating hosts & guests to have a Thanksgiving meal together on November 26. If you’re interested, please email admin@cpcnewhaven.org or fill out the form.

announcements.title: Hill Christmas Store | Donate by Sunday, December 6
announcements.description: Please join us in our 13th annual Hill Christmas Store! We will be sharing Christmas joy with families from New Haven’s Hill community. Purchase and leave an unwrapped gift valued at $20 or more for a child in the designated category (e.g., “Girl, 9–14”). In the spirit of empowerment, your gift will in turn be bought at a very reduced price by families in the Hill at the store. Please reach out to Kaitlyn Jessee with any questions.

announcements.title: Pastor Drop-in Office Hours | Craig, Fridays 7:30-10:30am | Jerry, Wednesdays Noon-3:00pm | Other hours available upon request
announcements.description: Drop in for a casual time of discussion, Q&A, prayer, coffee, tea, really whatever you want to make it! If you have a more private or formal need, you’re always welcome to set up a separate time with Pastor Craig (craig.luekens@cpcnewhaven.org), or Pastor Jerry (jerry.ornelas@cpcnewhaven.org) but this is meant to be a space where anyone can drop in.

announcements.title: Life Groups and Discipleship Groups
announcements.description:
Life Groups and Discipleship Groups are our way of doing “church in the small” where we meet throughout Greater New Haven to be engaged in prayer, teaching, fellowship and care.
For information on which Life Group may be a good fit, email admin@cpcnewhaven.org.

announcements.title: CPC Mercy Ministry Care Teams
announcements.description: CPC Care Teams have been created to serve as church-wide care for anyone in our congregation with a need. You can sign up for a team that matches your serving-ability or skill set, so that people at CPC are aware of the resources and gifts we have within our family, and thus can lean upon one another. Complete the interest form.
